Name: Craftable Incubator (works for 1.6)
Author: keithmfrench
Description:
Just Tested: Still Works with 1.6

Adds a craftable incubator: Now you can hatch more then one chick at a time.

Learned at Farming Level 4
Default cost 100 hay, and 50 hardwood. Can be change in the config file.
Can be broken and moved.
NOTE: They can be placed anywhere, but only actually work in the Coop, Big Coop, and Deluxe Coop.


WARNING: breaking it with an egg in it you get "error" item and loose the egg. Does not hurt your game in anyway. Just throw it in the trash. You will have wasted a bunch of materials. Can't fix this, so don't ask.

To install:
Unzip into Mods Folder.

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548]Kaya[/url] for the translations.
